name: MongoDB
description: Import an existing MongoDB database (Atlas or self-hosted): read-only database/collection discovery, probabilistic schema inference, relationship candidates with confidence, index and validator analysis, batched extraction, and relational/JSONB/hybrid mapping to PostgreSQL. No source mutation. Real change stream CDC: insert/update/replace/delete capture with durable signed resume tokens (Phase 35.6).
author: Backend Control Plane (first-party)

ui.setup_instructions: Provide a mongodb:// or mongodb+srv:// connection URI (stored encrypted; the built-in driver requires no PHP extension). Use least-privilege read credentials: the built-in 'read' role is sufficient for the entire flow. Select the database to import, review inferred schema and relationship candidates, then choose per-collection mapping strategies (relational, JSONB or hybrid).
